child_tool_info.description: Calculate source-defined signed spectral point counts and relative thermal-signal summaries from an explicitly received versioned CD JSON File. Retain ordered measurements, units, original point identities, partial results and the source-labelled heuristic qualifications. Thermal summaries use min-max relative signal, the first sampled point nearest one half, and the source's N-point transition width. These are descriptive source heuristics, with no calibrated structure fractions, fitted melting parameters or function-confidence probabilities. Alternatively read literal stored values or recalculate the retained sheet with the same numerical authority. Explicit selected-row views preserve original ordinals and the full original populations; neither saved mode acquires data or republishes the original Source.
